dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you just say "making money"? Tell me more about it

dialogues.speaker: Khitrov
dialogues.text: Heh, not to brag, but yours truly was the real deal up in the northlands once upon a time. Ran all the most profitable outfits, I did.

dialogues.speaker: Khitrov
dialogues.text: Snezhnayan ore, fine wine from Mondstadt, Sumeru's canning tech... You name it, I made a pile off it.

dialogues.speaker: Khitrov
dialogues.text: Back in the day, your reputation was the only currency that mattered. Everyone from the big-time officials to the street bosses — they all gave me tons of respect.

dialogues.speaker: Khitrov
dialogues.text: None of that matters now, pal. These Fatui types are too hung up on rules. You don't see the free-wheeling action we had back in the Snezhnaya of old anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Khitrov
dialogues.text: So I'm packing it all up and heading elsewhere, where hopefully I'll find... what do you call it... the meaning of life.
